name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $110 as Iran reports more tankers hit at Hormuz
state: Brent traded near $109.7 early on 2 Nov, just under the $110 Alert line but up 9% over the month, and remains at Alert under the board's hysteresis rule. Iran's IRGC said two tankers struck mines and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz on 1 Nov, while talks on a two-day plan to reopen the strait continue.
for_you: Expect continued high petrol, diesel and heating-oil prices, with knock-on effects on transport costs and inflation.
rubric_hit: Brent $109.7 near $110 Alert line; Hormuz largely shut

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Iran war live: Tankers hit in Hormuz; Trump again says conflict to end soon

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
